blockers: No production deployment exists. The stack is now rehearsed end-to-end locally (compose up, migrations, first-boot, smoke 5/6, deliberate tag-pin rollback executed and restored) and a Caddy TLS terminator is wired and config-validated, but no host, domain or certificate exists. Operator deferred provisioning by choice this run.
killerFeatures: Permission-aware retrieval enforced by Postgres RLS inside the vector scan, not as a post-filter
Provenance plus review gate: agents propose, humans promote, every canonical fact traces to its session
Contradiction adjudication and temporal validity, so facts are resolved and know when they stopped being true
acceptedRisks: RUSTSEC-2023-0071 (Marvin timing side-channel in rsa): dated reasoned deny.toml ignore. Reachable from one call site that SIGNS a service-account JWT with a local key; the attack targets PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption, which this workspace never performs. No upgrade exists upstream and openssl-sys is banned. Removal condition written into the entry.

Console operator gate is a single shared passcode with no per-user identity. Bounded this run (minting can no longer name a principal that is not an org member) but not replaced. OIDC/SCIM is already the stated target in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 2.1.
Console session cookie max-age is 400 days and the brute-force throttle is per-instance in-memory.
